capability.description: Calls OpenTDB with one optional amount argument, defaulting to amount=3. Category and all other filters are ignored because the wrapper never reads them. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: General trivia question retrieval; not an assessment engine, answer validation service, or category-filtered quiz builder.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional amount at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and OpenTDB result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional question count string; default is 3
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://opentdb.com/api.php with amount=<arg or 3>
category, difficulty, type, encoding, token, and pagination inputs are ignored/not exposed
wrapper does not locally truncate, decode HTML entities, or paginate questions
no authentication, cache, retry, or guarantee of deterministic question selection

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing OpenTDB response code and generated trivia questions, URL, and HTTP status.

negative_intents: grade an assessment or provide authoritative exam content

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing OpenTDB response code and generated trivia questions, URL, and HTTP status.
